story: Alex leaned back into the worn velvet armchair, letting the heavy weight of the day slide off his shoulders like a discarded coat. He watched a single dust mote drift through a shaft of golden afternoon light, his breathing slowing into a rhythmic, effortless tide. The distant hum of the city faded into a blur, leaving only the steady tick of the grandfather clock to anchor him to the present. He closed his eyes, feeling the tension evaporate from his jaw and forehead. A slow, genuine smile touched his lips as he simply existed in the quiet stillness of the room.

Every muscle in his jaw loosened as he surrendered to the stillness of the empty house.

He watched the amber light of the setting sun stretch across the hardwood floor, tracing the slow dance of dust motes in the air. His breathing deepened, becoming a slow, rhythmic tide that steadied his racing heart. With a steady hand, he sipped the lukewarm tea, feeling the warmth spread through his chest like a soft blanket. The distant hum of the city faded into a quiet blur, leaving him alone with the rhythmic ticking of the grandfather clock.
